description:
Return curated information about Bad Kleinkirchheim and the house for a topic.

Use for "what can we do there?" questions: skiing (winter), hiking, biking and lakes (summer), thermal
spas and the in-house sauna (wellness), golf incl. the free green fee and tee-time booking, families,
workation, arrival. The Kärnten Card (summer only) and the free green fee are explained exactly. Not for
prices or availability (check_availability) and not for apartment facts (get_apartment_details).
Behaviour: read-only, static curated content from the property (no web search), instant.
Returns text plus structuredContent.topics (topic, lines) and contact details.

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

topic.description: One of winter, summer, wellness, golf, family, workation, arrival (aliases like 'ski', 'wandern', 'anreise' work); empty = overview
topic.title: Topic
